correctness.rationale: The transfer map is a volume-preserving triangular bijection; conditioning on all but one coordinate yields exactly the covariance identity from total variance. Uniform order-polytope density is MTP2 by lattice closure, so FKG gives nonnegative covariance. Holley slice stochastic monotonicity, nonconstant increasing conditional expectations, and strict one-variable Chebyshev association give positivity exactly at an internal chain vertex. Uniform linear-extension Dirichlet order statistics supply an independent exact rational formula and checks.
